P_RECALL_PCT: recall below this % hp when safe / out of the fight
P_RECALL_NEAR: recall allowed with the nearest foe this many tiles away (caster draft)
P_BAIL_PCT: abandon a camp fight below this % hp
P_AVOID_DIST: back away from an unfavourable group this close
P_GA_AVOID_HP: back away from an unfavourable group below this % hp
P_ENGAGE2: favourable fight = our hp near the target >= this % of theirs
P_GA_FAV: favourable fight without a target = our hp >= this % of theirs within 8
P_GA_KILL_X: killable target = its hp <= our strength x this / 10 (always engage)
P_LOWHP: below this % hp with a foe within 6: back off
P_GA_SPAWN_HEAL: stay on spawn healing until this % hp
P_FRONT_ZONE: front line: a foe this close means we are in the fight
P_FRONT_OUT: front line: give up when their hp is above this % of ours
P_KITE_ZONE: kite: nobody within this many tiles and not hit = keep farming
P_KITE_OUT: kite: give up when they outnumber us by more than this...
P_GA_KITE_HP: ...and their hp is above this % of ours
P_VOLLEY: pathing avoids tiles where ready enemy damage >= this % of our hp
P_CHASE_GEMS: chase a foe only when it carries this many gems
P_DANGER: this many enemy champions together mark a danger spot
P_DANGER_T: a danger spot lasts this many rounds
P_DANGER_R: camps within this of a danger spot are skipped
